Mapping application - lifetimes and semantic ownership
|
|-- App services (createMappingServices; shared through context)
|   |-- canvasHistory: DefaultCanvasHistoryService -> [archive]
|   |-- workspaceStorage: WorkspaceStorage -> [archive]
|   `-- diagramGenerator / codeRepo (HTTP service adapters)
|
`-- MappingPocPage / MappingServicesContext.Provider
    `-- MappingWorkspacePage (page lifetime; /evals is a separate consumer)
        |-- CanvasWorkspace
        |   |-- controllers: Map<documentId, controller> (session references)
        |   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
        |   |   |-- DraftMetadata: name, repository, saved baseline, viewport
        |   |   `-- CanvasSession (one per document)
        |   |       |-- CanvasCursorCopy
        |   |       |-- Read-only observable stores
        |   |       |   |-- document / presentation / selection / controls
        |   |       |   `-- geometry (bounds, cell, version) / status (dirty, undo)
        |   |       |-- Saved baseline + cached scene/edge keys
        |   |       |   `-- updateBaseline(acknowledged save); sceneDirty = scene only
        |   |       |-- Commit listeners -> workspace.onPersist(ids)
        |   |       `-- MappingDocumentController
        |   |           |-- CanvasEditingContext handle -> shared history service
        |   |           |-- ControllerSnapshot -> [snapshot]
        |   |           |   `-- document: MappingGridDocument / canvas: MappingCanvasState
        |   |           |-- Command facade + publication -> [commands]
        |   |           |   `-- applyUpdate / transact / updateCanvas / undo
        |   |           `-- Optional editor driver (attached reference, not editor ownership)
        |   `-- setDrafts(): create sessions; replacement/removal unsubscribes + disposes
        |
        |-- MappingEditorCanvas (mounted per rendered draft; not session-owned)
        |   |-- tldraw Editor: live geometry, camera, native undo navigation
        |   `-- MappingEditorRuntime (holds editor/controller references)
        |       |-- publish(): snapshot -> mapping-box shapes + checkpoint metadata
        |       |-- settle(): completed gesture -> controller.commitEditorGesture()
        |       |-- Native checkpoint change -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint()
        |       `-- dispose(): settle, remove listeners and detach editor driver
        |           (pointer/camera frames do not commit semantic document state)
        |
        |-- SourcePaneViewState: personal camera/pane state -> persistence
        |-- WorkspacePersistence adapter -> [archive]
        |-- PromptComposerCoordinator -> [agents]
        |-- useAgentCanvasBridge + DiagramRevisionReceiver -> [agents]
        |-- Storage reference: injected App service; page-owned fallback if absent
        `-- Startup: representations + storage.load() -> reconcile -> setDrafts()
